title: `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` should support dynamic tool calls
body:
### Description

## Problem

Currently, `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` checks for `isToolUIPart` in the last tool invocation to see if it has finished streaming output.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/6fb1b4378f5f9f390d08ef932660bc17e65c186b/packages/ai/src/ui/last-assistant-message-is-complete-with-tool-calls.ts#L29

However, `isToolUIPart` does not support `dynamic-tool`s.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/6fb1b4378f5f9f390d08ef932660bc17e65c186b/packages/ai/src/ui/ui-messages.ts#L274-L278

This makes `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` return `false` wherever dynamic tools are used.

## Possible solutions

Checking for `dynamic-tool` part along with `isToolUIPart` `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` would solve this issue.

Changing `isToolUIPart` could be dangerous as it is used in many places other than `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls`

## Workarounds

Implementing `lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithToolCalls` with support for dynamic tools and plugging it into `sendAutomaticallyWhen` of `useChat` is one workaround.

### AI SDK Version

- `ai: 5.0.0`
